source: NPCI — UPI Product Statistics, monthly table for October 2026 (accessed 2026-11-26).

prior_year_same_month.reason: NPCI's retrieved October 2026 monthly table did not include a definitionally identical October 2025 comparison.

conversion.source: RBI / FBIL reference rate published for the last business day of October 2026

notes: NPCI publishes UPI volume and INR value only. Average ticket size (₹1,238.06 ≈ US$12.998) is arithmetic: total value ÷ volume. USD totals use the official RBI/FBIL rate of ₹95.2492 per US$ on 2026-10-30. NPCI excludes same-account debit/credit transactions from August 2018 onward and may revise monthly figures.
